metadata.title: Your move · Mudaro
metadata.description: Tell us what you are taking on your move.

home.title: Open the link you received
home.text: This page only works with the link to your request. Ask the moving company for it if you cannot find it.

link.invalidText: It may have been replaced by a new link or be incomplete. Ask the moving company to send it again.
link.errorTitle: Your request could not be opened
link.errorText: Please try again in a moment.

header.title: Hi {name}, what are you taking?
header.subtitle: {company} prepares the quote from what you list here. You can do it bit by bit: it is saved.

expired.title: Editing has closed
expired.text: The inventory can no longer be changed from this link. If you still need to change something, contact {company}.

submitted.title: Inventory sent
submitted.text: {company} received your inventory on {when}. The proposal will appear on this same link.

summary.title: Going in the truck
summary.declared: Approximate volume. The company confirms it in the quote.
summary.roomEmpty: No items yet. Use the Add button.

extras.title: Extra services
extras.subtitle: Tick what you would like the company to do. The price appears in the quote.
extras.notePlaceholder: E.g. upright piano, 2nd floor without lift
extras.footnote: If you are not sure what you need, leave everything unticked.

footer.hint: you can go back to any step
footer.hintLast: when you send it, the company receives the inventory

errors.accessIncomplete: Required access details are missing: floor, parking and lift for each address.
errors.empty: Add at least one item before sending.
errors.expired: Editing has closed. Reload the page.
errors.notFound: This link is no longer valid.
errors.noDraft: This inventory has already been sent. Reload the page.
errors.invalid: Some data is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.failed: Could not save. Please try again.
